verdict.rationale: Better Stack ships an AI SRE agent, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it can plug in MCP servers as a client. The evidence only documents Better Stack's own MCP server, which exposes its telemetry to external LLM tools like Claude Code and Claude Desktop. That is the server role and does not show the AI SRE consuming third-party MCP servers or their tools, so the axis applies but has no supporting evidence.
